ULFC.description: Unknown Load Factor Constraint (ULFC). TYPE selects the response quantity (reaction/displacement/truss/beam) constrained on object OBJ_ID; EQ selects between an equality target (bVALUE/VALUE/OtherObject) and an inequality band (bUB/UB_VALUE + bLB/LB_VALUE).

TYPE.description: Constraint type (case-insensitive). REAC = nodal reaction, DISP = nodal displacement, TRUSS = truss element force, BEAM = beam element force. Determines whether OBJ_ID is a node number (REAC, DISP) or an element number (TRUSS, BEAM) and the meaning of POINT and COMP.

OBJ_ID.description: Object ID: node number for REAC/DISP, element number for TRUSS/BEAM.

POINT.description: Result point index. For BEAM force: I-end=0, 1/4=1, 2/4=2, 3/4=3, J-end=4. For other types typically 0.

COMP.description: Component index of the constrained quantity. Reaction/Beam force: FX=0, FY=1, FZ=2, MX=3, MY=4, MZ=5. Displacement: DX=0, DY=1, DZ=2, RX=3, RY=4, RZ=5. Truss force: axial force.

EQ.description: Condition mode. true = equality condition (uses bVALUE, VALUE, OtherObject). false = inequality condition (uses bUB/UB_VALUE and bLB/LB_VALUE).

bVALUE.description: [EQ=true] Enable/flag for the equality target value.

OtherObject.description: [EQ=true] Other object ID referenced by the equality condition (0 = none).

bUB.description: [EQ=false] Enable upper bound. When true, UB_VALUE is applied; when false, upper bound is stored as 0.

UB_VALUE.description: [EQ=false] Upper bound value (applied only when bUB is true).

bLB.description: [EQ=false] Enable lower bound. When true, LB_VALUE is applied; when false, lower bound is stored as 0.

LB_VALUE.description: [EQ=false] Lower bound value (applied only when bLB is true).
